messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first hair color change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, turning her body from a side profile to face away from the camera, then rotating back to face forward while posing with her hands on her hips and adjusting her hair.","camera":"The camera is at a low angle, initially framing the character from the waist up and then tilting down to show her full body and feet.","clothing":"She wears a white one-piece romper with a floral pattern of purple, pink, and green, along with beige flat shoes.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Red hair is pulled up into a high bun with straight bangs across the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and light skin.","scene":"The setting is a European-style street with brick and stone buildings, black lampposts, and a Union Jack flag hanging on the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a modern rooftop with cranes and neon signs to a European-style cobblestone street with brick buildings, lampposts, and a Union Jack flag, closely matching the reference. The character's red hair, floral romper, pose sequence, and low-angle camera movement remain essentially the same, and the lighting now appears brighter and cooler, consistent with the new street environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original rooftop/construction environment with the European cobblestone street shown in the reference, including its lighting, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved exactly is difficult to judge from the available frames.
